items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: with Claude Hopkins and George James who used to be with Louis Armstrong in 1928... He got me the job and that's when I got to play for Bill Robinson

ctx.x: What kind of a thing did he have going on?

Well he was an arranger and he was doin' things that the public liked. And he would buy music. He had Tadd Dameron write some things for him. He had a white fella...I understand he's a professor at some college in Brooklyn. His name was Jerry Hefron and he did a lot of the arranging. He had a good book, you know. When we were in New York at the Zanzibar, he had Freddy Webster in the band, Idrees Sulieman and George James...he used to be with Louis Armstrong years ago. We broadcast three times a night and that's…
So the work at the club Zanzibar was when you first went with Sabby Lewis?
